## Environment

```bash
# Copy .env.example to .env and fill in values before first run
cp .env.example .env
```

Required environment variables:
# CATO_VAULT_PASSWORD: vault master password — ROTATE before Chunk 2 (owed since 2026-08-06 audit)
# ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: primary model provider key
# OPENAI_API_KEY: secondary/fallback model provider key
# GMAIL_CLIENT_ID / GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET / GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN: e4l-gmail-cli OAuth (triage lane)
# GMAIL_ADDRESS / GMAIL_REDIRECT_URI: non-secret Gmail config
# CATODESKTOP_BOT_TOKEN: Telegram bot token — ROTATE before Chunk 2 (predecessor-repo token owed)
# TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID / CATODESKTOP_BOT_USERNAME: non-secret Telegram config
# GITHUB_FOXFIREPOETS_TOKEN: gh API token
# SWARMSYNC_VERIFYAPI_KEY: SwarmSync proof-rail key (ssk_live_ prefix)
# PHOENIX_ENDPOINT / PHOENIX_API_KEY: OPTIONAL — Chunk 4 eval logging; falls back to local log file if unset/unreachable
# FINANCEOS_CONTROL_ROOM_URL: OPTIONAL — Chunk 5; if capability-token mint (O2O-FOS-1) is not yet live on FinanceOS, Chunk 5 must still pass by rendering the stale/unavailable state
